skill.summary: Design a revenue model for a solopreneur business — how money flows in, from whom, and on what cadence. Use when deciding how to monetize a product or servic...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "revenue-model-design" skill.
- Provides a structured framework for designing and selecting revenue models for solopreneur businesses.
- Covers recurring, one-time, usage-based, and marketplace/commission revenue models with detailed pros, cons, and best-use cases.
- Includes a step-by-step playbook: survey of model types, model selection criteria, revenue stream stacking principles, payment flow design, and revenue projection templates.
- Designed to help with decisions on monetization strategy, balancing revenue streams, and aligning business models with product delivery and customer needs.
